Subject: Oral history request for NovusCare — schedule & media release

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for agreeing to help us capture NovusCare's rollout story. Were hoping to record a short oral-history style interview (45 minutes) with the people who led the deployment so we can build a concise case study and short customer video. The output will be reviewed by you before publication and well share draft copy.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Dec 2, 10:30 - 11:15am
- Wed Dec 3, 2:00 - 2:45pm
- Thu Dec 4, 9:00 - 9:45am

Attached: a one-page agenda and our standard media release form. Quick asks: can you confirm which slot works best, and whether the participants below are ok to be recorded and quoted?

Planned Redwood attendees: me (Product Partnerships), Marissa Cole (Customer Marketing), Naomi Feldman (Customer Success). If it helps for technical context we can add Stephanie Nguyen (Product Marketing) as a second PM.

Attachment stubs: case-study-agenda.pdf (1 page), media-release-form.pdf (standard release).

If youd like, we can also send a short questionnaire beforehand — I attached a draft of the interview questions for visibility.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Partner
Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

- Mateo Alvarez — lead interviewer / product partnerships (moderator)
- Marissa Cole — customer marketing (story & comms)
- Naomi Feldman — customer success (technical ops liaison)
- Stephanie Nguyen — product marketing (optional, will listen and help shape quotes)

Agenda (45 min):
1) Quick intros (5 min)
2) Project summary & timeline (10 min)
3) Challenges + solution deep-dive (15 min)
4) Results / KPIs + quotes (10 min)
5) Next steps & review timeline (5 min)

Well record the session for internal note-taking and to pull short audio/quote snippets for the case study. Per your earlier question, we ask for an electronic sign-off on the attached media release before publication; if Legal needs up to 3 business days thats fine — well share the draft copy and an internal review timeline afterward.

Ive attached a short set of draft questions (draft-questions.docx) so your team can prep. I will send a calendar invite to the Dec 2 10:30am PT slot and include the recording consent form for signature; please let me know if someone else should be looped in.

Thanks again — looking forward to the conversation.
Mateo
